summary: MZ73 GPU job 1421 left the queue with producer exit code 1 at ordinary ML-NEB step 157. The O-H local path collapsed across images 04-06 and exceeded the single-atom-step guard; no complete dual-model path was produced.

payload.objective: Review the job 1421 O-H reaction-coordinate collapse and select a separately authorized correction; do not retry automatically.
current_evidence: Job 1421 is absent from the live Slurm queue and its producer exit record reports exit code 1 at 2026-09-01T14:23:08Z; completed-job accounting is unavailable, so this is producer-process rather than scheduler-accounting evidence.
The ordinary MatRIS ML-NEB reached step 157 but did not converge; its latest reported optimizer force was 0.410777 eV/A after an earlier spike to 3.781726 eV/A.
The O47-H49 sequence became 2.6900, 3.2128, 2.9858, 2.4685, 2.5354, 0.9988, 0.9913, and 1.1365 A, showing early backtracking and collapse of images 05-06 into an over-short bonded region.
The maximum single movable-atom step was 1.233302 A across images 04-to-05, above the request limit of 1.2 A; no internal image remained in the 1.1-1.8 A transition interval.

C1-C2, C2-O, and C1-H48 preservation, adjacent RMSD, minimum-distance, and periodic-branch numeric checks passed. The failure is localized to reaction-coordinate redistribution rather than global fragmentation or PBC discontinuity.
AQCat25 fixed-path audit did not run because the primary MatRIS path failed before a complete path manifest was created.
payload.one_executable_step: Present the failure diagnosis and await user direction on a local correction or a VASP-local route; do not resubmit job 1421 or alter the method automatically.
payload.submission_boundary: The job-1421 authorization is exhausted. GPU retry, VASP, ML-CI, fine-tuning, Dimer, frequency, and barrier actions require new explicit authority and a current hash-bound execution gate.
done_when: The user selects a concrete correction or downstream VASP route.
Any new execution package passes fresh geometry review and the applicable hash-bound gate.
